user_mindset: Post-meeting reviewer: tired, wants a grounded Obsidian note and proof that Margins used the important moments.
promise: A user can move from a finished customer call to a trusted note, inspect how the note was generated, and ask for one refinement without losing context.
journey: Observe progress before note text appears.
Inspect how-generated/provenance details while the note remains primary.
Ask for sharper action items and preserved open questions.
Confirm the refined note updates in place.
typed_refinement: Make the action items sharper, preserve the open questions, and keep the note concise enough to review in two minutes.

falsifiable_claims.claim: The user can tell note-making has started before the first note token appears.
falsifiable_claims.could_be_false_if: The UI sits on a generic loading state or shows no new information for several seconds.

falsifiable_claims.claim: The note remains the primary artifact while provenance is available.
falsifiable_claims.could_be_false_if: Tool/progress boxes visually dominate the generated note.

falsifiable_claims.claim: Refinement feels like continuing the same distillation.
falsifiable_claims.could_be_false_if: The UI resets to a blank run, loses the original note, or hides whether the saved note changed.
